sections.heading: Arrays
sections.body: Arrays are used to store multiple values in a single variable, instead of declaring separate variables for each value. To create an array, define the data type (like int) and specify the name of the array followed by square brackets []. To insert values to it, use a comma-separated list inside curly braces, and make sure all values are of the same data type: We have now created a variable that holds an array of four integers.

sections.heading: Avoid Mixing Data Types
sections.body: It is important to note that all elements in an array must be of the same data type. This means you cannot mix different types of values, like integers and floating point numbers, in the same array:
